image_description: A grey and black tabby cat lying on a grey carpeted floor. The cat is curled up with its head resting near its hind legs. The coat features distinct dark stripes and swirls typical of a classic or mackerel tabby pattern. The eyes are closed or squinting. The tail is visible with ringed patterns.
